_comment: Heavy-main-group alpha-vs-experiment test. Static isotropic dipole polarizabilities alpha0 in atomic units (Bohr^3), converted from CCCBDB (NIST) experimental polarizability volumes in Ang^3 via alpha[a.u.] = alpha'[Ang^3] * 6.74833 (= 1/Bohr_in_Ang^3). No molecular C6 reference is used here (those are paywalled for these heavy molecules); the test is whether RPA@PBE alpha stays uniform and whether TS's per-element volume-ratio failure reproduces across MULTIPLE Si compounds (SiH4 vs SiF4). SiH4 included for the Si-atom-vs-Si-molecule contrast (its alpha came from the dosd2 run).

SiF4.note: CCCBDB 3.319 Ang^3 — 2nd Si compound, the atom-vs-molecule test
